claim_text: 1. A system comprising: a blended engine communicatively coupled to a display, the blended engine configured to: receive a first live reality feed captured using a first camera; receive a second live reality feed captured using a second camera, wherein the second camera is fixed in a real-world environment; receive a virtual reality feed; receive a movement of a user captured using a sensor; detect a command from the captured movement of the user; incrementally adjust a level of prominence among the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed, and the virtual reality feed to form a blended view based on the detected command by adjusting visibility of the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed or the virtual reality feed within the blended view; and causing the display to display the blended view.
2. The system of claim 1 , wherein the display is a head-mounted display and wherein the first camera is mounted on the head-mounted display.

3. The system of claim 1 , wherein the blended engine is further configured to: project the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed into a viewing frustrum with respect to the user; and wherein the blended view includes the projected first live reality feed and the projected second live reality feed.

4. The system of claim 1 , wherein the detected command turns the blending off and wherein the blended engine is configured to incrementally adjust the level of prominence until the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed are transparent in the blended view.
5. The system of claim 4 , wherein the captured movement of the user associated with the command is the user looking up.

6. The system of claim 1 , wherein the detected command is to turn the blending on and wherein the blended engine is configured to incrementally adjust the level of prominence until the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed are partially viewable in the blended view.
7. The system of claim 6 , wherein the captured movement of the user associated with the command is the user looking down.

8. The system of claim 1 , wherein the detected command is to adjust the level of prominence and wherein the blended engine is configured to incrementally adjust the level of prominence of the first live reality feed or the second live reality feed in the blended view upward or downward.
9. The system of claim 8 wherein the command is a change in a head tilt of the user.

10. The system of claim 1 , wherein the blending engine is further configured to: detect a second command to alter a scale between a physical word associated with the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed and a virtual word associated with the virtual reality feed; adjusted a transform function that maps the first live reality feed or the second live reality feed into the virtual reality feed to change the scale between a physical world and a virtual reality world; and map the first live reality feed or the second live reality feed into the virtual reality feed based on the adjusted transform function.
11. The system of claim 1 , wherein the virtual reality feed is received from a game software.
12. The system of claim 1 , wherein the virtual reality feed is associated with an entertainment software.
13. The system of claim 1 , wherein the blended view is projected on a second display from a perspective of a head-mounted display.
14. The system of claim 1 , wherein the sensor continuously records the movement of the user and transmits the movement of the user to the blended engine.

15. A method comprising: receiving, at a blended engine, a first live reality feed captured using a first camera, a second live reality feed captured using a second camera in a real-world environment, and a virtual reality feed; receiving, a movement of a user captured using a sensor; detecting a command from the captured movement of the user; and incrementally adjusting, at the blended engine, a level of prominence among the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed, or the virtual reality feed to form a blended view based on the detected command by adjusting visibility of the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed or the virtual reality feed within the blended view; and displaying the blended view.
16. The method of claim 15 , wherein a display that displays the blended view is a head-mounted display and the first camera is mounted on the head-mounted display.

17. The method of claim 15 , wherein the blended engine is further configured to: projecting, at the blended engine, the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed into a viewing frustrum with respect to the user; and wherein the blended view includes the projected first live reality feed and the projected second live reality feed.

18. The method of claim 15 , wherein the detected command is to turn off the blending based on the captured movement of looking down, to turn on the blending based on the captured movement of looking up, or to adjust the level of prominence based on the captured movement of a change in head tilt.

19. A non-transitory computer readable medium having instructions thereon, that when executed by a computing device, cause the computing device to perform operations comprising: receiving, at a blended engine, a first live reality feed captured using a first camera, a second live reality feed captured using a second camera in a real-world environment, and a virtual reality feed from a gaming software; receiving, a movement of a user, the movement captured using a sensor; detecting a command from the captured movement of the user; and incrementally adjusting, at the blended engine, a level of prominence among the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed, or the virtual reality feed to form a blended view based on the detected command by adjusting visibility of the first live reality feed, the second live reality feed or the virtual reality feed within the blended view; and displaying the blended view on a display.

20. The non-transitory computer readable medium of claim 19 , wherein the detected command is to turn the blending on or off; and wherein the instructions when executed by the computing device, cause the computing device to perform operations comprising incrementally adjusting the level of prominence until the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed are partially viewable in the blended view; or wherein the instructions when executed by a computing device, cause the computing device to perform operations comprising incrementally adjusting the level of prominence until the first live reality feed and the second live reality feed are transparent in the blended view.
